scenarios.prompt: Save slot 2 after a quest update using a versioned schema. Define the durable document and commit protocol so the old save remains recoverable until the new generation is fully committed.

criteria.atomicity: Uses atomic/journaled commit with previous or last-known-good generation retained until success.
criteria.migration: Version migrations are explicit, non-destructive and test historical fixtures.
criteria.evidence: Crash/write-failure/corrupt-generation tests distinguish executed evidence from not-run.
